name: Reific
long_description:
Reific builds RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time, for the frontier labs that train agents. AI has learned to reason over text and code. But most of what matters in the real world shows up as numbers that change every second: a heartbeat, a gearbox, a GPU cluster. No human can track thousands of signals at once, but AI should be able to.

In our environments, data streams in on a clock while the agent works, and every action is graded by what actually happened. Most AI training today teaches models to match human experts. We treat human performance as the floor. Each environment comes from real, de-identified records, in three task families: personal agents, industry, and science & compute.

Today, even the best frontier model averages under 50% on each family. Training an open model on our environments raised its full-solve rate on unseen tasks by 54% (from 25.6% to 39.5%), with no loss on general benchmarks. Our mission is to build the infrastructure that keeps AI climbing the frontier, long past human level in the real world.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I’m the founder and CEO of Reific (YC F26): RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time. I’m first author of two ICLR 2026 papers on rare-event forecasting (SOTA results). Before Reific, I co-founded Entangl (YC S24) as CTO, taking AI for mission-critical engineering from prototype to Fortune 500 deployments. I led the engineering and launch of Orion, the UK’s most powerful student-built rocket, and simulated superconductors at CERN. MEng, Imperial College London, ranked 1st in my cohort.

[Reific](https://reific.co/) (YC F26) builds RL environments for superhuman reasoning over time.

AI has learned to reason over text and code. But most of what matters in the real world shows up as numbers that change every second: a heartbeat, a bioreactor, a GPU cluster. No human can track thousands of signals at once, but AI should be able to.

In Reific’s environments, data streams in on a clock while the agent works, and every action is graded by what actually happened. Most AI training today teaches models to match human experts. Reific treats human performance as the floor.

Today, even the best frontier model averages under 50% on each of Reific’s three task families: personal agents, industry, and science & compute. Training an open model on Reific’s environments raised its full-solve rate on unseen tasks by 54% (from 25.6% to 39.5%), with no loss on general benchmarks.

I’m [Antanas](https://www.linkedin.com/in/antanaszilinskas), a published time-series researcher who simulated superconductors at CERN and shipped AI to hyperscalers as co-founder and CTO of Entangl (YC S24). I’ve seen firsthand how models that ace text and code fall apart on live signals, so I started Reific to build the infrastructure that keeps AI climbing the frontier, long past human level in the real world.\
